item_short_desc: Rothco's Work Shirt features a heavy weight 100% cotton shell with a fleece lining and zip up collar.
description: Rothco's Navy Blue Work Shirt features a heavyweight 100% cotton shell with a fleece lining and zip up collar. In addition, the Firefighter / EMS work shirt has a large right chest pocket with a small inner pocket, elbow patches, key holder tab and knit waist and cuffs.
